title: windowless_spawn answers a waited-on child with no console window
intention: windowless_spawn answers a waited-on child with no console window and no detach, so a site like the tester's run_owned takes its flag from the tool instead of hand-building CREATE_NO_WINDOW.
why: Measured 2026-11-16 on akiendelllinux: both windowless_spawn seals stand red (test_a_cairn_spawn_opens_no_console_window tooth no_site_hand_builds_a_flag_set, test_every_detached_spawn_takes_its_flags_from_the_helper tooth the_site_check_scans_and_reds_a_hand_built_site), and both name one site: cairn/devices/tester/runs.py hand-builds creationflags / CREATE_NO_WINDOW (ef0c76c4d, ticket 715d2205a2ec). run_owned waits on its child inside a job object, so detached_kwargs is the wrong answer for it, and the tool offered no other.
traces_to: Law 1 and RULE 1: one answer for spawn flags in one tool, so a site does not re-derive a Windows flag by hand; the tool's own site check (ticket bce45318b2e0) is how that is kept.
how: windowless_spawn.py grows windowless_kwargs(kw=None, os_name=None): a copy of kw, with CREATE_NO_WINDOW OR'd into creationflags on nt and nothing added elsewhere. The site scan in test_a_cairn_spawn_opens_no_console_window.py counts a site taking windowless_kwargs as helped. A red-first proof injects the OS.

clauses.claim: on nt windowless_kwargs() is exactly {'creationflags': CREATE_NO_WINDOW}, with no DETACHED_PROCESS and no new process group
a caller's keywords pass through: its creationflags keep their bits with CREATE_NO_WINDOW added, its other keys stand, and the dict it handed in is unchanged
off nt windowless_kwargs(kw) equals kw as a copy, and {} for none
the site scan counts a Popen site taking windowless_kwargs as helped and still reds a hand-built flag beside it

decisions.text: D1: windowless_spawn.py gains windowless_kwargs(kw=None, os_name=None); detached_kwargs is unchanged.
D2: unhelped_sites accepts windowless_kwargs beside detached_kwargs; every hand needle stays.
D3: the red-first proof injects the OS, one tooth per clause.

measured.saw: both windowless_spawn seals red, every red line naming cairn/devices/tester/runs.py
measured.how: bin/cairn test --exec over the two sibling proofs on akiendelllinux

measured.saw: the new proof red on the base, all four teeth (no windowless_kwargs; the scan flagged a windowless_kwargs site)
measured.how: bin/cairn test --exec over cairn/tools/windowless_spawn/proofs/test_a_windowless_child_takes_only_the_no_window_flag.py in the windowless-kwargs-helper worktree
